name: @wirecat/cli-memo
stderr:
Usage: memo mcp [options] [command]

serve memo commands over MCP on stdio or authenticated HTTP, limited by saved
permissions — `claude mcp add memo -- memo mcp serve`

Options:
  -h, --help        display help for command

Commands:
  serve [options]   serve memo's commands to an AI agent
  revoke [options]  forget every login given to a browser app
  server            run the HTTP MCP server in the background
  help [command]    display help for command
